# Divin Gavran

> Personal website of Divin Gavran: a Data Scientist with a Physics background (Master's) who builds games, apps, and music. This page summarises the site for AI agents.

## About

- **Profession:** Data Scientist — data analysis, model training and deployment, data pipelines, anomaly detection, automations. Learned Python, simulations, and machine learning during a Master's in Physics (research on planet formation and Deep Learning for X-ray diffraction analysis).
- **Creative work:** Game development (formerly Playdate, now cross-platform with Bevy, a Rust game engine), web apps, and music — sampling-based beats released under the name _Divin_ (formerly also _Karasu-san_).
- **Languages:** German (native), English (fluent), Japanese (learning).
- **Interests:** AI and machine learning, playing games, reading books.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.divingavran.com/): site overview plus a "What's happening recently?" timeline of the latest releases.
- [About](https://www.divingavran.com/about/): background, education, work, and interests.
- [Games](https://www.divingavran.com/games/): games Divin has created, with links to itch.io.
- [Apps](https://www.divingavran.com/apps/): apps Divin has created.
- [Music](https://www.divingavran.com/music/): music releases with embedded Bandcamp players.
- [Journey](https://www.divingavran.com/journey/): a life timeline of milestones, achievements, and creative releases.

## Notable projects

- [No Invaders Allowed](https://slightlyoddstudio.itch.io/no-invaders-allowed) (2026): fast arcade action game — defend Earth from an orbital satellite.
- [Last Steps Home](https://divingavran.itch.io/last-steps-home) (2026): cosmic horror platformer made in 3 days with Bevy.
- [Siege of Syracuse](https://divingavran.itch.io/siege-of-syracuse) (2024): action game about Archimedes defending Syracuse with mirrors.
- [Double Check](https://divingavran.itch.io/double-check) (2024): charming puzzle game about double-checking before leaving.
- [Tana](https://github.com/divin/tana) (2026): privacy-friendly, self-hosted watch-history tracker for Jellyfin.
- [Kanji Match](https://divingavran.itch.io/kanji-match) (2025): cross-platform app for mastering visually similar Japanese kanji with WaniKani integration.
- [memento mori](https://divingavran.itch.io/memento-mori) (2025): Playdate app reflecting on the preciousness of time.
